    Home/Learn/Best peptides for weight loss: what is FDA approved

    Best peptides for weight loss: approved, compounded and research-use.

    Peptide Chooser editorial team. Checked 30 Oct 2026.

    Short answer

    Semaglutide (Wegovy) and tirzepatide (Zepbound) are both peptides, sold on prescription.12 Compounded copies are not FDA approved,3 and retatrutide is still in trials and sold only by research-use shops.4

    Which peptides are used for weight loss?

    Semaglutide and tirzepatide are peptides: short chains of amino acids that act like gut hormones. Semaglutide acts on the GLP-1 receptor;5 tirzepatide acts on two, the GIP and GLP-1 receptors.6 Our weight loss page lists the options people ask about:

    • Semaglutide (Wegovy): FDA approved. A weekly shot1.
    • Tirzepatide (Zepbound): FDA approved. A weekly shot.2
    • Compounded semaglutide or tirzepatide: not FDA approved. Pharmacy-made copies, sold by online clinics on prescription.
    • Retatrutide: not approved, still in trials. Sold online only by research-use shops.

    Which are FDA approved?

    • Wegovy (semaglutide): to reduce excess body weight and keep it off in adults with obesity, or with overweight and a weight-related condition.1
    • Zepbound (tirzepatide): for the same groups, and to treat moderate to severe sleep apnea in adults with obesity.2

    Ozempic (semaglutide) and Mounjaro (tirzepatide) are the same medicines approved for type 2 diabetes, not for weight loss.56 Compounded copies and retatrutide are not FDA approved.

    How much weight did people lose in the trials?

    In the STEP 1 trial, 1,961 adults with obesity or overweight took weekly semaglutide or a placebo for 68 weeks, with diet and exercise advice. Those on semaglutide lost 14.9% of their body weight on average, against 2.4% on placebo. Nausea and diarrhea were the most common side effects.7

    In the SURMOUNT-1 trial, 2,539 adults took weekly tirzepatide or a placebo for 72 weeks. Average weight loss was 15.0% to 20.9% depending on the dose group, against 3.1% on placebo. The most common side effects were in the gut, mostly while the dose was being raised.8

    The two trials were run separately, in different people, so their numbers are not a head-to-head comparison.

    What about compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide?

    A compounded version is a copy made by a pharmacy for a patient with a prescription. The FDA does not check its safety, effectiveness or quality before it is sold.3 Pharmacies could make copies while the medicines were in short supply; the FDA says both shortages are over.9 Online clinics still sell compounded plans.

    The FDA warns that some sellers use salt forms (semaglutide sodium or acetate), which are different ingredients from the one in the approved medicine.10 Our guides on compounded semaglutide prices and compounded vs brand GLP-1 go further.

    What is retatrutide, and can you buy it?

    Retatrutide acts on three receptors: GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon. In a phase 2 trial, 338 adults with obesity or overweight took it or a placebo weekly for 48 weeks; average weight loss was 8.7% to 24.2% depending on the dose group, against 2.1% on placebo.11

    Its status in our database: not approved (in clinical trials; no approved product).4 A research-use vial is labeled not for use in people, and it is not an approved medicine. Our guide on what research use only means explains the label.

    What do they cost?

    Prices are the clinics' published monthly prices. Some add a care fee; our weight loss page lists every plan with its care fee and each clinic's FDA warning letters.

    So what are the best peptides for weight loss?

    On the evidence in people and FDA approval, semaglutide (Wegovy) and tirzepatide (Zepbound). Both had large average weight loss against a placebo in long trials, and both are approved for weight management. Retatrutide had large losses in one phase 2 trial, but it is not approved, and what research-use shops sell is labeled not for use in people.

    None of this is medical advice. Your prescriber can tell you which medicine and which dose fit you.

    Questions about weight loss peptides

    What is the best peptide for weight loss?

    Semaglutide (Wegovy) and tirzepatide (Zepbound): both are FDA approved for weight management, and both had large average weight loss against a placebo in long trials. Retatrutide is not approved and is still in trials.

    Are weight loss peptides FDA approved?

    Wegovy (semaglutide) and Zepbound (tirzepatide) are FDA approved for weight management. Compounded copies and retatrutide are not.

    How much weight do people lose on semaglutide and tirzepatide?

    In the STEP 1 trial, people on semaglutide lost 14.9% of their body weight on average over 68 weeks, against 2.4% on placebo. In the SURMOUNT-1 trial, people on tirzepatide lost 15.0% to 20.9% over 72 weeks, against 3.1% on placebo.

    Is retatrutide FDA approved?

    No. Its status in our database: not approved (in clinical trials; no approved product). It is sold online only as a research-use vial.
